scares.description: The young girl suddenly breaks out of her dome.
The creature grabs the train conductor.
An alien hand pierces the cubicle and impales the girl on the toilet.
A squirrel jumps out of a tree and latches onto Laura.
A homeless man jumps out of a dumpster startling Dan. A couple of seconds later Dan turns around and finds himself face to face with Sil. [Video].
Preston startles the rest of the group in the sewers.
The creature jumps out of the water and grabs Fitch. [Video].
